title: Aureline M5 operational-readiness-review / rehearsal packet
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a launch-bearing operational-readiness-review or rehearsal packet — a monthly ORR, a release-candidate ORR, a publish/rollback drill, a mixed-version drill, an advisory/revocation drill, or a support/incident handoff drill. Names the packet kind, the readiness scope it covers, the required named role roster (release owner, advisory owner, support-room owner, docs/comms owner, and backup signer / on-call coverage), and the rehearsal-freshness expiry, and whether the packet is current rather than stale, skipped, or contradictory, so no stable claim widens on tribal memory and stable/LTS promotion halts automatically when the rehearsal packet is red or stale. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's readiness posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
